description_en: Deletes the SSH key pairs of simple application servers
description_zh: 删除轻量应用服务器密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open delete-key-pairs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --key-pair-names testKeyPair --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteKeyPairs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The names of the SSH key pairs. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with http\:// or https\://. You can specify the names of a maximum of 50 SSH key pairs
parameters.help_zh: SSH密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。最多支持50对SSH密钥对
parameters.name: key_pair_names
